keyPhrases.text: You'd have to have a Grinch-size heart not to feel a smile spreading across your face
energetic little charmer raises such a merry clatter
wins points for being less glitzy and more soft-spoken
Not that there's much story to speak of

reasoning: Mixed review with genuine charm and appeal noted (tap-dancing child, nostalgic warmth) but significant structural criticisms (lack of story, episodic narrative). Positive elements are heartfelt but tempered by substantive reservations about the material itself.
